page.overview:
Who is Drowned?

Ranged (with trident): Easy: Normal: Hard: Ranged (with trident): Easy: Normal: Hard:

Adult:Height: 1.95 BlocksWidth: 0.6 Blocks Baby:Height: 0.975 BlocksWidth: 0.3 Blocks : Adult:Height: 1.9 BlocksWidth: 0.6 Blocks Baby:Height: 0.95 BlocksWidth: 0.3 Blocks

Drowned are common neutral underwater zombie variants that spawn in oceans, rivers and dripstone caves, or when zombies drown. They usually attack through melee attacks, but may also come armed with tridents that they throw. They are the only source of tridents, and the only renewable source of copper.

Drowned spawn naturally at light level of 0 in all ocean biomes, aquifiers in the dripstone caves biome, and river biomes. They spawn at higher rates in rivers and dripstone caves than in ocean biomes.
